title: Differential compatibility of the constructed ordinary evaluation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open, and $P,F$ arbitrary cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_U$-modules. Put $D_P=\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,\mathcal O_U[0])$ [def-pur-hom-complex] and $T=\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes D_P)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Define $E^n:T^n\to\mathcal Hom^n(P,F)$ by the coproduct and product universal properties: its $(p,q)$ tensor summand followed by the Hom projection indexed by $r$ is the ordinary evaluation component of [lem-pc-strictly-perfect-ordinary-evaluation], zero unless $r+q=0$, and otherwise the currying of evaluation on $P^r$ followed by the unit action on $F^p$. Then for every $m=n+1$, $E^n d_{\mathcal Hom}^{n,m}=d_T^{n,m}E^m$. No strict perfectness or boundedness is assumed.

proof.text: Construct the graded maps by the Hom product lifts and total-tensor coproduct descent, and establish their component formula by the two universal-property factorization equations.

Use Mathlib mapBifunctor.hom_ext to restrict to each tensor summand and Fan.IsLimit.hom_ext to test every Hom-complex product projection. Apply ordinaryEvaluation_differential_summand to the constructed degree maps, supplying localEvaluationDegreeMap_formula. Associativity identifies the composites and completes the differential identity.
